title: feat: report five measured or unknown kernel-call timing fields (NFR-05)
body:
## Scope

Implement only NFR-05: additive `timing` on newly rendered responses and journal call records, scoped to `kernel-call`.

- `active` and `tool` are measured elapsed milliseconds; overlapping, rejected and timed-out Runner calls count once in the tool interval union.
- `provider`, `network` and `userWait` preserve exact host observations with timestamps, or are null with unknown provenance. The shipped plugin does not observe these host fields. Invalid/failed host observations fail explicitly; no estimates or null-result fallbacks.
- Preserve stored schema, cumulative active-budget semantics, legacy optional cached responses and historical timing snapshots.
- Update help, public documentation, canonical technical/UX specs, deterministic timing fixtures, historical-retry regression and built UAT assertions. Closed-registry refusal tests supply only timing ports and still prove no repository state creation.

## Shared capacity dependency

Reuses the unchanged approved D01b capacity-only commits `f5ad92c` / `1acf8bf` (cherry-picked as `f134cb6` / `15fc299`) and portability-only repair `070bb23` (as `640c6f0`). These set central capacity to exactly 400,000 characters and bundle capacity to 900 KiB; this PR introduces no separate limits or schema-2 runtime. No INS-05, NFR-07 or AGT-12 implementation.

Capacity is separately reviewed in #9. A read-only preview predicts a later CHANGELOG conflict after that prerequisite merges; preserve all feature entries and corrected capacity disclosure in any owner-authorized branch update. No branch rewrite or merge performed here.

## Exact-head evidence

Head: `c146269cdec6f52c2df296ed6a05c63dfbe11b2e`.

[Untrusted run 42408963882, attempt 2](https://github.com/vedprakash-m/tenet/actions/runs/42408963882): **success**. Ubuntu/macOS full CI and real-repository built UAT pass on Node 24 and 22.12; Windows portability passes every step. The duplicate same-head push run 42408961206 was still running its macOS job at this evidence update.

Preserved failure history: attempt 1 passed both POSIX jobs but a Windows copied starter schema-history test exceeded its unchanged 5-second deadline. Only the failed Windows job was retried after the whole run completed, at unchanged source; it passed. Starter source is identical to baseline and another passing cohort; observed run variation is not an isolated root cause. No timeout, evaluator or product logic was relaxed.

Local Windows: 34 timing/trace/quality tests, four timing-only transport refusal controls and 11 repaired portability controls pass. Typecheck, all lints, M0 structural coverage, build, payload verification and reproducibility pass. Built scratch help/status/unknown-verb/unsupported-mutation responses carry the five fields with unknown host provenance. Staged and publication-range privacy checks found no likely leaks (not proof of absence).

Windows kernel mutations remain unsupported; native-host timing observations remain unobserved. Local planning/spec records remain git-ignored.

## Owner review

Executable/effects change: preserve the solo **72-hour review window**. Owner merges; no merge or main push is authorized for the agent.
